wf-ink.purpose: The default room: page and VitePress background. Inverts to #f7f7f5 in light mode.

wf-ink-raised.purpose: Hover and raised dark surfaces. Inverts to #ffffff in light mode.

wf-ink-rule.purpose: Dividers and structural rules, and the resting colour of --wf-marker. Inverts to #d8d8d4.

wf-optic.purpose: Main sign text and banner lettering. Inverts to #0a0a0a in light mode.

wf-optic-dim.purpose: Secondary labels on the substrate. Inverts to #5c5c5c in light mode.

wf-hall-a.purpose: Copilot Studio, the home banner tint, and --wf-marker-live. 5.99:1 on white.

wf-hall-b.purpose: Copilot Cowork. 7.34:1 with its on-hall ink.

wf-hall-c.purpose: Declarative Agents. 5.09:1 on white, after the Red Correction.

wf-hall-d.purpose: Selection, focus rings, tickets and high-signal strips. 15.83:1 with its on-hall ink.

wf-hall-e.purpose: Added when the programme outgrew four rooms. 6.76:1 with its on-hall ink.

wf-on-hall-a.purpose: Measured ink for text sitting on Hall A blue.

wf-on-hall-b.purpose: Measured ink for text sitting on Hall B mint.

wf-on-hall-c.purpose: Measured ink for text sitting on Hall C red.

wf-on-hall-d.purpose: Measured ink for text sitting on Hall D lime.

wf-on-hall-e.purpose: Measured ink for text sitting on Hall E orange.

venue.purpose: Huge record and display moments such as event counts. clamp(3.2rem, 0.5rem + 12vw, 11rem) at weight 900.

sign.purpose: The signage register: uppercase, wide, tight-tracked. Every page title and navigable label. Components often raise it to 900 for page titles.

read.purpose: The reading exception. Blog posts and talk abstracts, in sentence case at a 68ch measure.

label.purpose: Small caps-tracked labels, normally dim optic unless sitting on a hall field.

motion.name: wf-motion
motion.purpose: The only duration. Signage changes state, it does not travel.

motion.name: wf-ease
motion.purpose: Cut, hard and directional. Fast out of the gate, settled at the end; nothing overshoots or bounces.

motion.name: arrow-advance
motion.purpose: The only positional move in the system: a sign row’s terminal arrow steps forward on hover and focus.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every transition collapses to an instant state change.

components.name: Sign Row
components.description: The atom of the world: a full-width directional sign with a colour tab, a cut label, an optional note and a terminal arrow. Never shorter than a thumb.
components.html: Speaking recordEvery event, and what is coming up next.→

components.name: Sign Row — Door
components.description: The door variant of a sign row: same anatomy at a larger label register, used where a row is an exit rather than an item. Carries its hall standing still.
components.html: Session resources↗

components.name: Ghost Action

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 42px; padding: 0 0.875rem; border: 1px solid var(--wf-ink-rule, #2a2a2a); background: transparent; color: var(--wf-optic, #fff); font-family: var(--wf-font, Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 110; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: background var(--wf-motion, 120ms) var(--wf-ease, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)), color var(--wf-motion, 120ms) var(--wf-ease, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)), border-color var(--wf-motion, 120ms) var(--wf-ease, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { background: var(--wf-optic, #fff); border-color: var(--wf-optic, #fff); color: var(--wf-ink, #0a0a0a); } .ds-btn-ghost[data-copied="true"] { background: var(--wf-hall-d, #c8ff00); border-color: var(--wf-hall-d, #c8ff00); color: var(--wf-on-hall-d, #101400); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--wf-hall-d, #c8ff00); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Wayfinding is built from one thesis: the site is the venue and every page is a sign. It owns the world of conference environmental graphics: matte vinyl colour fields, optic-white cut lettering, oversized directional arrows, hall-letter tiles, and full-bleed hanging-banner photography. The form seed is `8b56bdc1`, candidate 3, and the direction contract is shipped into every page head from `src/.vitepress/contract.ts`.

The site rejects the usual developer-advocate layout of portrait, bio line, feature cards, gradient hero and timeline. It also rejects an editorial broadsheet. The user is often holding a phone in a dark room after a session, so navigation is not decoration: rows, halls, doors and arrows are the interface. The one recorded staging idea, `converging-pair`, is used only on the session placard via `SpeakerCard`, where two speaker plates on one baseline become one billed session block.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed near-black substrate with optic lettering: `--wf-ink`, `--wf-optic`, `--wf-ink-rule`.
Hall colours are fields, not accent text: `--wf-hall-a` through `--wf-hall-e` carry `--wf-on-hall-*` ink.
Every navigable thing tries to become a sign row with a terminal arrow.
Reading content gets an explicit exception: prose keeps the venue but leaves the signage register.
Motion is cut, hard and directional; signage does not bounce.

rules.name: The Contrast Law Rule
rules.body: Hall colours are field colours carrying white or black text; never set small hall-coloured text on the substrate. The measured shipping pairs are Hall A `#1F4BFF` on white at 5.99:1, Hall B `#00C2A8` with `#04231F` at 7.34:1, Hall C `#D6203A` on white at 5.09:1, Hall D `#C8FF00` with `#101400` at 15.83:1, and Hall E `#FF6B00` with `#1A0A00` at 6.76:1.

rules.name: The Red Correction Rule
rules.body: The original red `#FF3D57` measured only 3.47:1 and was darkened to `#D6203A`. Do not restore the brighter red.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Every underline, tab and rule that marks a navigable thing waits in `--wf-marker` and lights `--wf-marker-live` on hover and focus. Standing still the marker is anatomy, not decoration; live, it is the way out. A row that genuinely belongs to a hall overrides the live colour with that hall’s own. Markers sitting on a saturated hall field are the one exception and stay `currentColor`, because a grey rule on Hall A blue disappears. This rule governs the nav, the sign tabs, prose links, the `clear` controls and every board exit.

rules.name: The Marker Ink Rule
rules.body: `--wf-marker-live` is a *marker* colour, not an ink one. Hall A on the dark substrate measures 3.31:1, which passes the 3:1 floor for a 2px rule and fails the 4.5:1 floor for text. Wherever the live colour is a word rather than a rule — the nav’s current and hovered items — it must use `--wf-marker-live-ink` (`#4D74FF`, 4.96:1). Light mode needs no lift: flat Hall A on paper measures 5.99:1.

rules.name: The No Fade On Fields Rule
rules.body: Opacity must never be used to dim text sitting on a hall field. `0.85` opacity dropped Hall C to 4.01:1 and Hall A to 4.74:1. Signage separates by scale and weight, never by fade.

rules.name: The Reading Exception Rule
rules.body: Blog posts and talk abstracts drop out of the signage register into a real reading measure, currently `--wf-measure: 68ch` and about 623px rendered. They keep the substrate, hall colour and rules, but use sentence case. Caps-at-venue-scale governs wayfinding, not prose.

rules.name: The Specificity Trap Rule
rules.body: `.VPPage .vp-doc > div` suppresses the reading measure on full-bleed signage pages, while `.VPDoc .vp-doc > div` applies it to prose. Do not use a plain `.vp-doc > div` measure rule; it loses to the higher-specificity suppression.

rules.name: The Navbar Offset Rule
rules.body: Below 960px the VitePress navbar is in normal flow; at and above 960px it is fixed. Therefore `.VPContent` gets `padding-top: var(--vp-nav-height)` only inside `@media (min-width: 960px)`. Applying that padding at all widths double-offsets mobile; applying it nowhere crops signage under the navbar.

rules.name: The Door Rule
rules.body: `/r/` resource pages are full-viewport hall fields (`background: var(--hall); color: var(--on-hall)`) with safe-area padding and a max-width sheet of 44rem. They must stay minimal because Product Principle 1 is “The QR path is the critical path.”

rules.name: The No Shadow Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce ambient cards, glows or soft elevation to solve hierarchy. Use a rule (`1px` or `3px`), a hall field, a larger sign register, or a directional arrow.

dos: Do use `--hall` and `--on-hall` together whenever a hall field carries text.
Do keep navigable objects as full-width rows or doors with arrows and at least `--wf-tap` height.
Do use `BannerImage` for photography, with hall tint and scrim intact.
Do preserve `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` and keep motion to instant state changes or directional arrow slides.
Do keep prose in `.wf-read` / `.VPDoc .vp-doc > div` at `--wf-measure` instead of stretching it across the venue.
donts: Don’t use small hall-coloured text on `--wf-ink`; hall colours are fields, not link colours.
Don’t dim text on hall fields with opacity; the measured failures are known.
Don’t put photography on `/r/` resource pages, or make a resource page wait on decorative assets.
Don’t use circular portraits, soft cards, gradients or stock VitePress ornaments inside committed Wayfinding surfaces.
Don’t apply `padding-top: var(--vp-nav-height)` to `.VPContent` below 960px, and don’t remove it above 960px.
